You will see the best of local street food, heritage, temple, sightseeing, river cruise information and so much more in this episode.
I planned 5 episodes series in which i spent one and a half day in Bangkok and then proceeded towards Singapore.
Details of activities done during this journey of Bangkok are given below.
Date of journey - 30th june.
On Lok Yun - location - near Old Siam Plazz - This is a 90 year old eater, don’t be surprised if you see a Que for breakfast.
Kaya toast 38 Baht
Signature coffee hot 30 Baht
Cold 35 Baht
